jobs.description:
As our Astronaut, your missions are:

  • Own AIRO engineering delivery. Design, build, release, and operate customer-facing AI capabilities across product discovery, supported cart and payment journeys, platform assistance, and post-purchase support, in partnership with the relevant service owners.
  • Discover and validate problems. Understand customer journeys through feedback, usage data, and execution traces; embed with business users to observe workflows and investigate bottlenecks, errors, repetitive tasks, and knowledge gaps.
  • Define value before building. Establish baselines, identify accountable stakeholders, prioritize opportunities, and agree on success measures, acceptance criteria, and experiment stop conditions.
  • Choose practical solutions. Compare process changes, existing tools, system integrations, custom software, data solutions, and AI against expected value, delivery effort, operating cost, and risk.
  • Build and deliver end to end. Write, review, test, and deploy production software across APIs, integrations, data flows, automation, and user interfaces as needed. Iterate through small releases and direct user feedback.
  • Apply AI to real workflows. Integrate approved models and shared AI capabilities; implement retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, and agent workflows where justified by the problem.
  • Evaluate quality and reliability. Define representative customer-journey and workflow evaluations, investigate failure modes, and implement appropriate access controls, confirmation, human escalation, fallback, and recovery behavior. Validate conversation context, factual grounding, and the correctness of actions across retries and partial failures.
  • Drive adoption and improve experience. Work with Product and Design on customer usability and task completion. For internal workflows, co-design with users, demonstrate progress, train users, and address adoption barriers.
  • Own production operation. Coordinate releases, monitor reliability, latency, AI quality, and cost, troubleshoot incidents, and continuously improve AIRO and assigned solutions. Establish ongoing ownership explicitly and transfer support only through an accepted handover.
  • Prove business impact. Compare results with the agreed baseline and recommend whether to scale, improve, transfer, or stop an initiative.
  • Make learning reusable. Document decisions, runbooks, integrations, and delivery patterns; share platform needs and reusable improvements with the relevant engineering owners.

  • Ability to define success criteria and use data and feedback to evaluate customer outcomes, adoption, and business impact.
  • Sound judgment about security, access permissions, sensitive data, and the consequences of automated actions.

jobs.description:
About this Position
This role focuses on building and optimizing high-performance Android applications that deliver smooth, responsive, and seamless user experiences. You will collaborate with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams to develop new features, improve application performance, and deliver fluid UI transitions and animations comparable to leading quick-commerce applications such as Blinkit and Zepto. You will also take ownership of performance profiling, troubleshooting, and optimization across app startup time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, memory consumption, and UI rendering. Additionally, you will explore and leverage AI tools to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows.

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

  • Lead the development, optimization, and maintenance of Android applications, ensuring high performance, reliability, scalability, and code quality.
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve performance bottlenecks related to app startup time, screen load time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, memory consumption, and UI rendering.
  • Implement smooth UI transitions, animations, gestures, and micro-interactions to deliver a responsive and seamless user experience comparable to Blinkit and Zepto.
  • Profile and optimize Android rendering performance, scrolling behavior, frame rendering time, and main-thread execution to minimize UI jank and frozen frames.
  • Collaborate with Product and Design teams to translate UI/UX requirements into polished, high-performance Android experiences.
  • Establish performance benchmarks, monitor production metrics, and continuously improve application responsiveness and resource efficiency.
  • Lead technical design discussions, break down complex engineering problems into actionable tasks, and ensure timely, high-quality feature delivery.
  • Perform code reviews, mentor engineers, and promote best practices in Android development, performance optimization, testing, and maintainable architecture.
  • Take ownership of the full product lifecycle, including development, testing, release, production monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Explore and leverage AI tools or technologies to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows, including coding, debugging, refactoring, test generation, and documentation.
  • Evaluate AI-generated code and solutions to ensure correctness, security, maintainability, and performance before integrating them into production applications.

jobs.name: Senior Android Engineer
jobs.qualifications:
In order to launch successfully, you need to have:

  • Minimum 3-4 years of experience in software engineering, with strong hands-on experience in native Android application development.
  • Strong proficiency in Kotlin, Android SDK, Android Jetpack libraries, and modern Android development practices.
  • Solid experience with Jetpack Compose and/or the Android View system, including advanced UI rendering, animations, transitions, and gesture handling.
  • Proven experience identifying and resolving Android performance issues related to application startup, screen load time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, frame rendering time, and memory consumption.
  • Hands-on experience with performance profiling and debugging tools such as Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, Android GPU Inspector, Firebase Performance, and LeakCanary.
  • Strong understanding of Android's rendering pipeline, frame deadlines, VSync, main-thread execution, garbage collection, memory allocation, and CPU/GPU utilization.
  • Proven ability to build smooth, responsive UI experiences, including complex animations, seamless navigation transitions, optimized scrolling, skeleton loading states, and interactive components.
  • Experience optimizing lists, image loading, caching, asynchronous processing, and background operations using technologies such as RecyclerView, Kotlin Coroutines, and Flow.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns, including MVVM or MVI, dependency injection, modularization, and clean code principles.
  • Experience with application performance monitoring, benchmarking, production troubleshooting, and regression prevention.
  • Practical experience exploring and using AI-powered development tools to improve coding productivity, debugging, testing, refactoring, and other everyday engineering workflows.
  • Ability to validate AI-assisted implementations and ensure that generated solutions meet production standards for performance, security, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including testing, CI/CD, release management, production monitoring, and maintenance.
  • Possesses a curious and proactive mindset, continuously seeking feedback, learning new technologies, and exploring better engineering practices to improve application performance and development efficiency.
